visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width rotating hero slides with autoplay, prev/next arrows, dots and a pause button; thumbnail-tabs options replace the dots with a row of thumbnail tabs under the slides

contentPattern.structure: One row per slide. Cells: optional picture-only background cell, then the content cell (eyebrow text, heading, text, CTA links/buttons), then an optional picture-only foreground image cell. With thumbnail-tabs / thumbnail-tabs-2 an optional last cell gives the tab label (and an optional thumbnail picture); without it the tab uses the slide heading and image. Empty rows/cells are ignored; extra text cells merge into the content

reuseGuidance: Use for top-of-page rotating hero banners. Use hero-banner for a single static hero and carousel-cards for scrolling card rows
